name: hand
description: Lossless session snapshot + restore for Claude Code. /hand:off archives transcript context into a deterministic trimmed brief (recap + status frontmatter) and a rebuildable SQLite index; /hand:on restores it after /clear. Browse, search, archive, and rename sessions with the `hand` CLI or a 2-pane Textual TUI. Explicit, no auto-compaction hooks.
